Pearl District.name: Pearl District
Pearl District.description: Former industrial district north of downtown converted to high-density residential and ground-floor retail and galleries.

Downtown & West End.name: Downtown & West End
Downtown & West End.description: Central business core with office-to-residential conversions and hospitality along the transit mall.

Goose Hollow & Providence Park.name: Goose Hollow & Providence Park
Goose Hollow & Providence Park.description: Stadium-adjacent residential hillside with mixed-use infill near the western downtown edge.

Buckman & SE Hawthorne.name: Buckman & SE Hawthorne
Buckman & SE Hawthorne.description: Dense inner-east neighborhood with retail corridors, ADU construction, and renovation-led permitting.

Kerns & Burnside East.name: Kerns & Burnside East
Kerns & Burnside East.description: Transit-adjacent east-burnside corridor with mid-rise multifamily replacing single-story commercial.

Laurelhurst & NE Broadway.name: Laurelhurst & NE Broadway
Laurelhurst & NE Broadway.description: Streetcar-era bungalow district meeting the NE retail spine, with renovation-heavy permits.

Eliot & N Williams.name: Eliot & N Williams
Eliot & N Williams.description: Rapidly densifying north corridor with infill multifamily along the N Williams bike/transit spine.

Boise & N Mississippi.name: Boise & N Mississippi
Boise & N Mississippi.description: Historic Albina bungalow stock under gentle upzoning pressure near the Mississippi arts district.

St Johns.name: St Johns
St Johns.description: Formerly independent north Portland town with small-lot infill and a village-scale commercial core.

South Waterfront & OHSU.name: South Waterfront & OHSU
South Waterfront & OHSU.description: OHSU-anchored high-rise academic medical district with continued tower construction on the Willamette's west bank.

Hillsdale & SW Macadam.name: Hillsdale & SW Macadam
Hillsdale & SW Macadam.description: Southwest hills neighborhood with teardown/rebuild pressure and strict slope ordinances.

Multnomah Village.name: Multnomah Village
Multnomah Village.description: Inner-southwest village node with indie retail and renovation-led permits.

Mount Tabor & SE Belmont.name: Mount Tabor & SE Belmont
Mount Tabor & SE Belmont.description: Hill-adjacent east-side neighborhood with ADU construction and corridor multifamily.

Woodstock & SE Foster.name: Woodstock & SE Foster
Woodstock & SE Foster.description: Outer-southeast arterial with affordability-pressure infill and small-lot development.
